content.rendered:
Sherwood High School

Be Engaged. Be Proud. Be Together.

The Course Selection deadline for academic year 2025-2026 is Wednesday, February 3rd. If you are unable to submit your course selections, your counselor will choose classes based on what you need. If you have specific classes you would like, please email those selections to your counselor and they will do their best to accommodate. There will be a verification process for students the first week of June to see what courses have been selected for them and/or to request changes.

Incoming Freshmen

Course selection for incoming 9th graders will begin later in February. More information will be coming soon.
